name: prepare_recording
title: Prepare recording playback
description: Create or repair a local playback MP4 from the retained screen and microphone/system tracks of a stopped meeting. Preserve original separate tracks and mix both audio sources into one playable stream without truncating longer media. No transcription, minutes generation, or external media sending. Runs as a playback job; poll get_job_status and then get_meeting.playback. Reuses an artifact only when input hashes, parameters, producer and output hash match. Scope follows get_meeting. The request_id is an idempotency key; repeat only with identical input. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found, scope_denied, busy, invalid_argument (no retained video or audio), engine_unavailable, internal.
